### How Alcohol Metabolism Works

- **Elimination rate:** On average, the body eliminates alcohol at about **0.015% to 0.016% BAC per hour** , roughly equal to **one standard drink per hour**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXi1R5GkHEEXK8UnzsyOHxO2j4Q_n2Ydfv2RqF9svLFLFegbZE5GfsQtwt5nEGhL5SKtL7Z7MKcrlctNQqoW5PWp--T5w5TBcadp2Z10ZfB_fCIfdLHVngd-TfHFLor4C8_WX1_ERXH7oy8oZn8iCN7w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXfJY2Iv4PMsiZBReXEDIfxdTM7Mul5xlas59NnugcPvm2xUwFXvpkPe_tm6SOzs0Hsf1dgIlFJNeYkPk6JYE5XqnhClZI79fnDfFPmgMR1X93s5N69n-SMkbdQfnkuRGsUnXj3oe4aO52zp4)
- **Absorption timing:** Alcohol typically takes **30 to 70 minutes** after drinking to reach peak levels in the bloodstream.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXi1R5GkHEEXK8UnzsyOHxO2j4Q_n2Ydfv2RqF9svLFLFegbZE5GfsQtwt5nEGhL5SKtL7Z7MKcrlctNQqoW5PWp--T5w5TBcadp2Z10ZfB_fCIfdLHVngd-TfHFLor4C8_WX1_ERXH7oy8oZn8iCN7w)
- **No shortcuts:** Coffee, cold showers, food, or extra water do not speed up liver metabolism; only time lowers BAC.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXwXO5AqFNu3_q1KzfegqAlz1iGKtgVGSJmBKiQwe6Ge7Tcku3HymgA0DcNCBKd1zqao42EsgMfbdANRJd90QUp0kTaG5AahtLw9_0E1QkJ4oyYlBcvmGc6QSy6A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXfJY2Iv4PMsiZBReXEDIfxdTM7Mul5xlas59NnugcPvm2xUwFXvpkPe_tm6SOzs0Hsf1dgIlFJNeYkPk6JYE5XqnhClZI79fnDfFPmgMR1X93s5N69n-SMkbdQfnkuRGsUnXj3oe4aO52zp4)
- **Estimates only:** Calculators rely on averages and do not account for individual differences like food intake, liver health, medications, or tolerance. Do not use a calculator to judge whether you are safe to drive.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1zRdj6uHKwjvz3c1gKTA2CyioLIxc5m68uLTMcfVrnvQM0c90Qlvw5Tw8R5m3oYD-XmJ5riLf6rLKDO8lEsZfafM_mssE-pL57qfPmswZpQaAwgY2uQXGv-cJXl7AsQryTpooEH5CajHKIuYCcRxKRS_Ao2r8VBo_oPExJWhXuIXwk0Hrzg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXwXO5AqFNu3_q1KzfegqAlz1iGKtgVGSJmBKiQwe6Ge7Tcku3HymgA0DcNCBKd1zqao42EsgMfbdANRJd90QUp0kTaG5AahtLw9_0E1QkJ4oyYlBcvmGc6QSy6A)

### Standard Drink Equivalents (U.S.)
One U.S. standard drink contains about **14 grams (0.6 fl oz)** of pure alcohol:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXxwNXFPpxJENP8fdi18EAfV7VGIz63hY6f5ZZc2Wp_sUfZbbQhhiLwecyn_tAEzQQZq5DU0srRXQMGCc7BFj4vkedzS9mAYLuAuwjboibGvLJ4tRnG-O8eQ7mn6FtiTeYei45rHmmsLJyMz8QK3JH6JYlHebXWkkkqg)

- **Beer:** 12 fl oz at ~5% ABV
- **Table wine:** 5 fl oz at ~12% ABV
- **Distilled spirits:** 1.5 fl oz shot at 40% ABV (80 proof)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXxwNXFPpxJENP8fdi18EAfV7VGIz63hY6f5ZZc2Wp_sUfZbbQhhiLwecyn_tAEzQQZq5DU0srRXQMGCc7BFj4vkedzS9mAYLuAuwjboibGvLJ4tRnG-O8eQ7mn6FtiTeYei45rHmmsLJyMz8QK3JH6JYlHebXWkkkqg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXi1R5GkHEEXK8UnzsyOHxO2j4Q_n2Ydfv2RqF9svLFLFegbZE5GfsQtwt5nEGhL5SKtL7Z7MKcrlctNQqoW5PWp--T5w5TBcadp2Z10ZfB_fCIfdLHVngd-TfHFLor4C8_WX1_ERXH7oy8oZn8iCN7w)
